Election Knowledge

Instructions:  Below are several descriptions dealing with what you know about the election. Please use the scale below to rate each.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

____ 1. I know the candidates' positions.

____ 2. I do not feel informed about the election.

____ 3. The voting rules are clear to me.

____ 4. My knowledge of the candidates is limited.

____ 5. I could explain each candidate's platform.

Recode: 2 & 4

Score should be between 5 and 25
